implemented: Pure std-only ChangeBundle domain model with ChangeSet, Claim, SymbolLock, manifest digest, attestation, provenance, semantic diff, evidence, KG edges, done emission, and promotion evidence.
Signature attestation validation uses deterministic non-empty signature/key/digest fields with allowlisted algorithms: ed25519, ecdsa-p256-sha256, cosign-keyless-v1.
Digest validation accepts sha256/sha512 hex digests with exact algorithm lengths.
Claim coverage validates working claims, write symbol coverage, and touched artifact coverage using oya-foundry-vcs-kernel ChangeSet/Claim/SymbolLock semantics.
Evidence freshness validates pass result, observation/expiry window, max age, lineage evidence presence, and artifact digest match.
Artifact/signature/provenance/evidence mismatch, stale evidence, protected ref mutation, unclaimed diffs, and uncovered artifacts quarantine the bundle.
Done emission returns a ChangeBundle without protected-ref mutation; promotion publication records controller evidence without mutating protected refs.
test_cases: done emits bundle without protected-ref mutation
